accounts.description: Specific Account IDs to sync. Must be populated if `syncMode` is set to `SpecificAccounts`.

ad_analytics.description: Whether to sync all analytic reports or specific. Default value: `AllReports`

post_click_attribution_window_size.description: The time period to attribute conversions based on clicks. Default value: `DAY_30`

reports.description: Specific analytics reports to sync. Must be populated if adAnalytics is set to 'SpecificReports'.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all accounts or specific accounts. Default value: `AllAccounts`

timeframe_months.description: Number of months for which to query reporting data included in the initial sync. This number cannot be modified once the connector is created. Default value: `ALL_TIME`.

view_through_attribution_window_size.description: The time period to attribute conversions based on views. Default value: `DAY_7`

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your LinkedIn client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your LinkedIn client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
